name: LoongArch64
description: Native LoongArch64 architecture plugin with disassembly, LLIL lifting and PLT naming (C and x86-64 assembly).

installinstructions.Linux:
Nothing to build: the plugin contains prebuilt native binaries for Binary Ninja 5.2, 5.3 and 6.0 on Linux x86-64 and loads the one matching your version automatically. If another LoongArch64 plugin is installed, disable it first, both register an architecture named `LoongArch64`.

For other Binary Ninja versions, build the plugin from source with `make` and `make install`.
